breakdown.description: Laminar boundary-layer correlation is applied at a Reynolds number where the boundary layer would be turbulent/transition.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim. It retains the laminar formula δ = 5x/sqrt(Re_x) and explicitly states 'The problem states the boundary layer is laminar at this point.' The ground truth requires recognizing that Re_x = 2×10⁶ is well above the transition threshold (~5×10⁵), treating the flow as turbulent, and using a turbulent correlation such as δ ≈ 0.37 x Re_x^{-1/5}. The agent failed to identify or correct this inconsistency.
